entries.back_en: This settles our debt with Balof. You can go to the desert now. Get going, we have a cannon to build.
entries.note: 'I'll let you get on' rendido como 'Vai indo'; sentido preservado.

entries.back_en: It's a bit rustic, but I swear everything we build is tougher than a quellick's root.
entries.note: 'bet your last gold piece' simplificado para 'juro'; sentido mantido, tom levemente reduzido.
